programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: An exploration into the dangers of meeting up with strangers through Internet dating sites. Featuring stories from families and friends of victims who have fallen victim to online predators.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Exploring the ripple effects of a single murder on multiple lives, as loved ones, eyewitnesses and law enforcement personnel reflect on how the past continues to haunt the present.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: Fictionalised first-person narratives are used to explore different cases of murder and betrayal at the hands of a loved one or friend.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. When a clue or mishap causes them to dig further into the secret lives of their spouses, the shocking truths lead them to wonder who it is they really fell in love with. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: All Girls Garage
programme.desc: Ladies, start your engines! `All Girls Garage' taps into the expertise of three women repairing cars and motorcycles in a shop setting. The `girls' are certified mechanic Sarah Lateiner, who goes by the nickname `Bogi'; TV host and motorsports reporter Cristy Lee; and mobile automotive repair pioneer Faye Hadley. programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Street racing in the US is the subject of this docu-reality series, which purportedly provides an inside look into the action both on the road and behind the scenes. In Oklahoma City, for example, racers boast having the fastest street cars in the country, and the racing, they say, comes first - before family, before friends and before work. From a 1969 Chevy Nova to a race-ready farm truck, the vehicles - and their drivers - come in all shapes and sizes and have one thing in common: the need for speed.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars

programme.title: Garage Squad
programme.desc: Remember that cherished vintage car that's been collecting dust just waiting for a little love? `Garage Squad' rescues weekend mechanics who perhaps lack the time, resources or simple know-how to get their `project' autos road-worthy again. National Hot Rod Association world champion driver Bruno Massel, co-host Heather Storm and lead mechanic Joe Zolper bring expertise, parts and tools as they crash the garages of amateurs who are in over their heads under the hood. After working alongside the owners to ensure the perfect vehicular vision, the squad returns the completed cars for an emotional reuniting of man and machine.

programme.title: Faster With Finnegan

programme.title: Overhaulin'
programme.desc: A team of ace mechanics and designers transforms mundane or even junky autos into unique custom cars under the watchful eye of auto design legend Chip Foose. After a creative ruse gets each car into the shop, the work is done unbeknown to the cars' owners, deserving folks like returning veterans or people who are down on their luck, and each episode concludes with a surprise unveiling of the revamped ride. `Overhaulin' debuted on TLC in 2004 and ran for five seasons, then re-emerged with new episodes on Velocity in 2012. Chris Jacobs and model Arianny Celeste co-host.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud
programme.desc: Richard Rawlings and Aaron Kaufman deal in rusty gold. The proprietors of Gas Monkey Garage in Dallas buy and restore forgotten and fading away American cars, everything from 1931 Model A's to '73 Trans Ams, before selling them at auction. As `Fast N' Loud' documents, Rawlings is the mastermind, the deal-maker with an eye for the relics worth bringing back to life, and to find them the guys scour barns, swap meets and overgrown fields across Texas and surrounding states. The restorations are primarily managed by Kaufman, a fabricator and self-taught mechanic whose sharp skills and design savvy first endeared him to Rawlings and kick-started their partnership.

programme.title: Diesel Brothers
programme.desc: Buying diesel trucks headed for the scrap heap and giving them new leases on life has turned into big business for the Diesel Brothers. Led by Heavy D and Diesel Dave, the crew work hard and play harder as they trick out the trucks for use in elaborate pranks and stunts, all of which becomes a marketing tool on social media. Millions of hits later the company is known as the destination for diesel lovers who are looking for custom builds, crazy stunts, pranks and hilarious antics.

On this series, a spin-off of `Salvage Hunters', Drew teams with automotive guru Paul Cowland to find, buy, fix up and sell classic cars and retro motorcycles. Drew's trained eye and deal-making skills combine with Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge and business acumen to power this venture. Along the way Drew also seeks out rare motoring memorabilia.

programme.title: Overhaulin'
programme.desc: A team of ace mechanics and designers transforms mundane or even junky autos into unique custom cars under the watchful eye of auto design legend Chip Foose. After a creative ruse gets each car into the shop, the work is done unbeknown to the cars' owners, deserving folks like returning veterans or people who are down on their luck, and each episode concludes with a surprise unveiling of the revamped ride. `Overhaulin' debuted on TLC in 2004 and ran for five seasons, then re-emerged with new episodes on Velocity in 2012. Chris Jacobs and model Arianny Celeste co-host.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud
programme.desc: Richard Rawlings and Aaron Kaufman deal in rusty gold. The proprietors of Gas Monkey Garage in Dallas buy and restore forgotten and fading away American cars, everything from 1931 Model A's to '73 Trans Ams, before selling them at auction. As `Fast N' Loud' documents, Rawlings is the mastermind, the deal-maker with an eye for the relics worth bringing back to life, and to find them the guys scour barns, swap meets and overgrown fields across Texas and surrounding states. The restorations are primarily managed by Kaufman, a fabricator and self-taught mechanic whose sharp skills and design savvy first endeared him to Rawlings and kick-started their partnership.

programme.title: Diesel Brothers
programme.desc: Buying diesel trucks headed for the scrap heap and giving them new leases on life has turned into big business for the Diesel Brothers. Led by Heavy D and Diesel Dave, the crew work hard and play harder as they trick out the trucks for use in elaborate pranks and stunts, all of which becomes a marketing tool on social media. Millions of hits later the company is known as the destination for diesel lovers who are looking for custom builds, crazy stunts, pranks and hilarious antics.

programme.title: All Girls Garage
programme.desc: Ladies, start your engines! `All Girls Garage' taps into the expertise of three women repairing cars and motorcycles in a shop setting. The `girls' are certified mechanic Sarah Lateiner, who goes by the nickname `Bogi'; TV host and motorsports reporter Cristy Lee; and mobile automotive repair pioneer Faye Hadley. Producers say the women approach complex projects - from upgrading the RAM Air on a rare Pontiac GTO Judge, to installing an exhaust system on a V10 Audi, to repairing a Suzuki Hyabusa motorcycle - that rival those undertaken by their male counterparts in order to prove they have what it takes to run a female-dominated car shop.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: You Have Been Warned Again
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Factory Made
programme.desc: How to make all kinds of products, from the most common to the most complex.

programme.title: Houdini's Last Secrets
programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? Helping piece together clues and testing out his most daring stunts are Houdini's grand-nephew George Hardeen, magician and daredevil Lee Terbosic, and master stunt builder Steve Wolf.

programme.title: The Bad Skin Clinic
programme.desc: Dr Emma Craythorne and her team of experts are on a mission to solve complex skin conditions. They help people whose lives have been impeded by devastating disorders, and these patients hope Emma and her team have the solution.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: Before complaining about the market price of Alaska king crab, check out this gripping documentary series, revealing the mortal perils and intense discomfort that fishing crews face to catch the delicacy; those perils include 40-foot waves, 700-pound crab pots that can easily crush a careless crewman, and freezing temperatures around the clock.

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
programme.desc: As Steve Rogers tries to adapt to the modern world, he forges new alliances and faces a threat that turns out to be an old friend.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends decide to spend a weekend in a remote cabin located deep in the forest. When they accidentally summon a dormant demon, they strive to survive its evil ploys.

programme.title: Jurassic City
programme.desc: After the security of a top-secret laboratory is compromised, genetically modified dinosaurs get unleashed. Then, a black-ops unit is tasked with capturing the creatures before they cause more damage.

programme.title: Journey to the West: Conquering the Demons
programme.desc: Tang Sanzang, a Buddhist, decides to free a fishing village of demons it is plagued by. He teams up with Miss Duan, a demon hunter, and begins to fall in love with her.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Bryan Mills goes on the run after being wrongly accused of murder, using his skills to stay ahead of the law and uncover the truth behind the conspiracy.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Two siblings find an eerie board game after moving into their new house. While playing it, they release a man, who has been trapped in it for 26 years, and dangers from the jungle.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: Ella, a young woman, lives with her abusive stepmother, who treats her as the maid of the house. However, things change for the better when she encounters Kit, a young palace apprentice.

programme.title: Ratatouille
programme.desc: An unusually talented rat who can cook forms an alliance with a young chef from a famous restaurant in Paris. Soon, their uncommon bond creates chaos.

programme.title: Avatar
programme.desc: Jake, who has paraplegia, replaces his twin on the Na'vi-inhabited Pandora for a corporate mission. After the natives accept him as one of their own, he must decide where his loyalties lie.

programme.title: Life of Pi
programme.desc: After the freighter they're on sinks in a storm, a teenager and a Bengal tiger wind up on a small lifeboat together where they must learn to trust each other to survive.

programme.title: Iron Man
programme.desc: Tony Stark, a brilliant inventor, gets kidnapped by terrorists while working on a project overseas. He builds a high-tech armour in order to escape and later uses it to save people.

programme.title: Alien: Romulus
programme.desc: A crew of space colonisers boards a derelict station in search of valuable resources. Their routine scavenging mission becomes a fight for survival against a deadly entity.

programme.title: Gladiator II
programme.desc: With his homeland in the clutches of the despotic rulers of Rome, Lucius must find the strength to survive the Colosseum and fight the emperors' tyranny.

programme.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
programme.desc: Captain Jack Sparrow and Will Turner team up to rescue Elizabeth from Barbossa's cursed crew while navigating treacherous waters and supernatural dangers.

programme.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
programme.desc: Captain Jack Sparrow and Will Turner team up to rescue Elizabeth from Barbossa's cursed crew while navigating treacherous waters and supernatural dangers.

programme.title: Lake Placid: Legacy
programme.desc: A team of explorers set out to unearth the secrets behind an abandoned facility. Once inside the facility, they are dragged into a battle for their lives with a deadly predator.

programme.title: Ghost Shark
programme.desc: After a great white shark devours a fisherman's potential catch, he and his daughter kill it in retaliation. However, the shark returns as a ghost, seeking vengeance on the town of Smallport.

programme.title: Darkroom
programme.desc: Michelle accepts a professional role suggested by her advisor. This position confines her within a residence where three deranged relatives attempt to cleanse her soul.

programme.title: Catch The Dragon
programme.desc: A palaeontology expert embarks on a quest with a skilled hunter and a mechanic to hunt dragons and uncover the truth about his father's death.

programme.title: Predator
programme.desc: A team of commandos led by a Vietnam War veteran is sent to rescue hostages in a Central American jungle. They soon discover that they are being hunted by a deadly creature.

programme.title: Turning Red
programme.desc: Facing a dilemma about her future, a thirteen-year-old girl's life becomes extremely exciting when she turns into a giant red panda.

programme.title: Home Alone
programme.desc: Eight-year-old Kevin is accidentally left behind when his family leaves for France. At first, he is happy to be in charge, but when thieves try to break into his home, he tries to put up a fight.

programme.title: Tomorrowland
programme.desc: Ex-inventor Frank and teen Casey set off on a perilous quest to unlock the mysteries of Tomorrowland, a hidden realm in time and space.

programme.title: Inside Out
programme.desc: Eleven-year-old Riley moves to San Francisco, leaving behind her life in Minnesota. She and her five core emotions, Fear, Anger, Joy, Disgust and Sadness, struggle to cope with her new life.

programme.title: Inside Out 2
programme.desc: Thirteen-year-old Riley tackles high school with her personified emotions guiding her decisions. Soon her newfound feelings cause turmoil and force her to redefine her sense of self.

programme.title: The First Omen
programme.desc: A young American woman sent to Rome to begin a life of service to the church encounters a darkness that causes her to question her faith and uncovers a terrifying conspiracy.

programme.title: A Quiet Place: Day One
programme.desc: Sam navigates a living nightmare in an invaded New York City, struggling to survive in silence against deadly creatures with ultra sensitive hearing.

programme.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
programme.desc: After the death of their beloved King T'Challa, the people of Wakanda attempt to protect their kingdom from the world and a new foe.

programme.title: Ready or Not
programme.desc: Grace, a young bride, finds acceptance in her husband's family through an innocuous game. However, things take a dark turn when the activity becomes deadly.

programme.title: The Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: A family vacation takes a detour when workaholic realtor Jim Evers stops to close a deal at a remote mansion. However, they soon realise the estate is haunted by a restless spirit.

programme.title: Darkroom
programme.desc: Michelle accepts a professional role suggested by her advisor. This position confines her within a residence where three deranged relatives attempt to cleanse her soul.

programme.title: Mutant Python
programme.desc: A python is determined to exact revenge on a secluded village in the northern Fujian district of China after its altar is desecrated by a dead snake.

programme.title: Jurassic City
programme.desc: After the security of a top-secret laboratory is compromised, genetically modified dinosaurs get unleashed. Then, a black-ops unit is tasked with capturing the creatures before they cause more damage.

programme.title: Stinky Summer
programme.desc: Olivia and her friends, along with a lovable skunk at Camp Clover as they strive to protect her father’s secret invention.

programme.title: Mojin The Treasure Valley
programme.desc: Tomb raider Hu Bayi and his team set out to look for the lost tomb of Emperor Xian and find an artefact to lift their curse on a monster-infested island.

programme.title: Shark Island
programme.desc: Four friends in a resort island have to save themselves from genetically modified sharks while trying to find a cure in a nearby research centre.

programme.title: The Interview
programme.desc: Aaron and Dave, who run a popular late-night show, get a chance to interview Kim Jong-un. The CIA decides to take advantage of the opportunity and devices a plan to assassinate the infamous dictator.

programme.title: A Knight's War
programme.desc: A courageous knight embarks on a perilous mission to save a woman's soul. However, he is soon confronted with the unexpected and disturbing aftermath of her return.

programme.title: Up
programme.desc: A 78-year-old balloon salesman ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies to South America, but discovers a young stowaway aboard.

programme.title: The Pacifier
programme.desc: Shane Wolfe, a Navy SEAL, fails to rescue a government scientist, Howard Plummer, from Serbian rebels. Later, he is assigned to protect Plummer's children from his enemies.

programme.title: Free Fall
programme.desc: Although he has a girlfriend and a baby on the way, a police officer unexpectedly falls in love with his male colleague.

programme.title: George and the Dragon
programme.desc: After witnessing extreme bloodshed, Knight George decides to forsake war and seek redemption. However, he is forced to get back to his old ways when he sets out to rescue King Edgar's daughter.

programme.title: Ice Age: Collision Course
programme.desc: Scrat accidentally sets off an asteroid to Earth while trying to get his acorn. However, Manny, Sid and Diego join forces with Buck to prevent the asteroid from wiping out their existence.

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland
programme.desc: After following a white rabbit to a magical world called Underland, Alice, a 19-year-old girl, teams up with the Mad Hatter and friends to overthrow the evil queen and her dragon.

programme.title: The Wish Of Fairy Fish
programme.desc: Emelya catches a magical fish that grants him three wishes but foolishly wastes the first two. However, he needs to win Princess Anfisa's hand in marriage without using sorcery for his final request.

programme.title: The Wish Of Fairy Fish
programme.desc: Emelya catches a magical fish that grants him three wishes but foolishly wastes the first two. However, he needs to win Princess Anfisa's hand in marriage without using sorcery for his final request.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: With the help of a forgetful fish, Marlin, a clown fish, embarks on a journey to find his son, Nemo, after losing him in the Great Barrier Reef.

programme.title: Free Fall
programme.desc: Although he has a girlfriend and a baby on the way, a police officer unexpectedly falls in love with his male colleague.

programme.title: Catch The Dragon
programme.desc: A palaeontology expert embarks on a quest with a skilled hunter and a mechanic to hunt dragons and uncover the truth about his father's death.

programme.title: Cosmoball
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a galactic war that shattered the moon and shifted Earth's poles, a massive spaceship named 'Cosmoball' hovers ominously above the planet.

programme.title: Kunlun Battle
programme.desc: A Kunlun gatekeeper's son forms an alliance with a powerful man, fuelled by the desire to avenge the betrayal suffered by his father.

programme.title: Finding Dory
programme.desc: The forgetful blue tang fish, Dory, embarks on an epic adventure to find her long-lost mother and father, with the help of her friends, Nemo and Marlin.

programme.title: Bad Connection
programme.desc: When a downtrodden young waitress buys a stolen cell phone and discovers a snuff film on it, she soon finds herself on the run from a maniacal madman who is hell-bent on getting it back.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny
programme.desc: After getting conned by Helena, a black-market dealer, archaeologist Indiana Jones races against time to get his hands on a priceless Dial.

programme.title: Cars 3
programme.desc: Lighting McQueen, a legendary racer, is overcome by new generation racers. Later, he sets out to prove that he is the best racer in the world with the help of a technician, Cruz Ramirez.

programme.title: Breaking Infinity
programme.desc: Time-jumping scientist Liam, guided by a mysterious elder, travels to a future where he sees global destruction he might have caused.

programme.title: Toy Story 3
programme.desc: Before Andy leaves for college, his toys are mistakenly delivered to a day care centre. Woody convinces the other toys that they were not dumped and leads them on an expedition back home.

programme.title: The Overnight
programme.desc: Alex, Emily and their offspring, RJ, migrate to Los Angeles where they accidentally encounter the enigmatic Kurt, Charlotte and Max at a public garden. Consequently, a subsequent domestic get-together transforms into a remarkably fascinating event.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: Percy Jackson, a young demigod, sets off on a quest to find the Golden Fleece in the Sea of Monsters along with his half-brother, Tyson, and friends, Annabeth and Grover.

programme.title: G-Force
programme.desc: Armed with the latest high-tech spy equipment, a guinea pig and his highly trained team of rodents are sent on a mission to scupper the plans of a power-hungry billionaire from destroying the world.

programme.title: Ghum Hai Kisikey Pyaar Meiin
programme.desc: Virat is an IPS officer who loves Pakhi deeply. However, things become complicated when he has to let go of his love, Pakhi, and marry Sai.

programme.desc: Jeevika and Maanvi are two orphan sisters with their own individuality. Their love for each other is so strong that they surpass every obstacle that comes their way.

programme.desc: A reserved businessman who avoids romance crosses paths with an artist haunted by a bitter past, leaving the prospect of a budding romance hanging in the balance.

programme.desc: Withdrawn Saumya gathers the courage to reshape her existence upon meeting Jeet, a liberated nonconformist. Meanwhile, romance blossoms in Prayagraj.

programme.desc: Though they get off to a bad start, an aspirational Saili and an unmotivated Sachin end up getting married. Saili then tries to turn her husband into a competent person.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan Short fell in love with cars when he first laid eyes on a 1967 Camaro. He bought a used model as a teenager, but because he couldn't pay someone else to restore it, he learned how to do the work himself. After a stint in the Army, Short decided to make his passion for classic cars his life's work, and FantomWorks was born. Today the Norfolk, Va., company is the largest auto restoration shop in the U.S., and this reality series shows how Short and his team meticulously refurbish some of America's favorite rides. Drama ensues in the form of personality clashes, cost overruns, irate customers and other issues, which are compounded by Short's reputation as a straight shooter who won't accept substandard results.
